description: Summary figure: catalytic positions across the LRAT/PLAAT family, vertebrate ortholog conservation, active-site geometry versus PLAAT3, and first-shell mapping with AlphaMissense constraint
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(17.5, 11.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.42, wspace=0.26)

# ---------------- Panel A: catalytic positions across the LRAT/PLAAT family
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
fam = [("LRAT",     "O95237","H60", "H72", "C161","LLWNNCEHFVT", 27.6),
       ("PLAAT1",   "Q9HDD0","N42", "H30", "C119","LLVNNCEHFVT", 27.7),
       ("PLAAT2",   "Q9NWW9","H23", "H35", "C113","LTSDNCEHFVN", 48.9),
       ("PLAAT3",   "P53816","H23", "H35", "C113","LTSENCEHFVN", 34.1),
       ("PLAAT4",   "Q9UL19","H23", "H35", "C113","IVSRNCEHFVT", 35.4),
       ("PLAAT5",   "Q96KN8","H145","H157","C233","LIEGNCEHFVN", 44.4),
       ("LRATD2",   "Q96KN1","H132","H144","S201","LSWRNSESFAA", np.nan),
       ("LRATD1",   "Q96KN4","H143","H155","S212","LTGRNSESFAA",100.0)]
cols = ["His 1", "His 2", "nucleophile", "nucleophile motif"]
axA.set_xlim(0, 4.6); axA.set_ylim(-0.5, len(fam))
for i, (nm, acc, h1, h2, nu, mot, pid) in enumerate(fam):
    y = len(fam) - 1 - i
    axA.text(-0.08, y, f"{nm}", ha="right", va="center", fontsize=11,
             fontweight="bold" if nm.startswith("LRATD") else "normal")
    for j, v in enumerate([h1, h2, nu]):
        bad = v[0] not in ("H", "C") or (j == 2 and v[0] != "C")
        axA.add_patch(Rectangle((j*0.72+0.05, y-0.33), 0.64, 0.66,
                      facecolor="#e8554e" if bad else "#9ecae1", alpha=0.85, edgecolor="grey"))
        axA.text(j*0.72+0.37, y, v, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10,
                 color="white" if bad else "black", fontweight="bold" if bad else "normal")
    axA.text(2.35, y, mot, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=10.5, family="monospace",
             color="#b2182b" if "SESFAA" in mot else "black")
for j, c in enumerate(cols[:3]):
    axA.text(j*0.72+0.37, len(fam)-0.35, c, ha="center", fontsize=10, style="italic")
axA.text(2.35, len(fam)-0.35, "nucleophile motif", ha="left", fontsize=10, style="italic")
axA.axis("off")
axA.set_title("A. The two catalytic histidines are kept, the nucleophilic cysteine is not\n"
              "(red = departs from the active-enzyme residue)", fontsize=12, loc="left")

# ---------------- Panel B: ortholog conservation
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
orth = [("Homo sapiens",100.0),("Canis lupus familiaris",99.3),("Sus scrofa",99.0),
        ("Bos taurus",98.3),("Equus caballus",97.3),("Rattus norvegicus",96.2),
        ("Mus musculus",95.9),("Gallus gallus",84.4),("Sarcophilus harrisii",83.2),
        ("Alligator mississippiensis",76.8),("Latimeria chalumnae",73.6),
        ("Xenopus tropicalis",72.8),("Ornithorhynchus anatinus",68.1),
        ("Danio rerio",64.6),("Oryzias latipes",64.6),("Takifugu rubripes",63.0)]
labels = ["His143","His155","Cys208","Ser212"]
M = np.array([[1,1,1,1]]*len(orth))
axB.imshow(M, cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=2, aspect="auto")
for i in range(len(orth)):
    for j, r in enumerate(["H","H","C","S"]):
        axB.text(j, i, r, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10,
                 fontweight="bold", color="#b2182b" if j == 3 else "black")
axB.set_xticks(range(4)); axB.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=10)
axB.set_yticks(range(len(orth)))
axB.set_yticklabels([f"{s}  ({p:.1f}%)" for s, p in orth], fontsize=9)
axB.set_title("B. Invariant in 16 of 16 vertebrate orthologs, human to fugu\n"
              "(percent identity to human LRATD1 in brackets)", fontsize=12, loc="left")

# ---------------- Panel C: active-site geometry
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
pairs = ["His1 N - nucleophile\n(ND1 to OG / SG)", "His1 - His2 dyad\n(NE2 to ND1)",
         "His2 - nucleophile\n(NE2 to OG / SG)", "nearest other Cys SG\nto nucleophile atom"]
lr = [3.12, 2.86, 8.46, 11.26]
p3 = [3.87, 2.72, 8.56, 0.00]
x = np.arange(4); w = 0.38
axC.bar(x-w/2, lr, w, label="LRATD1 (AlphaFold)", color="#e8554e")
axC.bar(x+w/2, p3, w, label="PLAAT3 (crystal 4DOT)", color="#4393c3")
for xi, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(lr, p3)):
    axC.text(xi-w/2, a+0.25, f"{a:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
    axC.text(xi+w/2, b+0.25, f"{b:.2f}" if b else "0 (is the Cys)", ha="center", fontsize=9)
axC.set_xticks(x); axC.set_xticklabels(pairs, fontsize=9)
axC.set_ylabel("distance (angstrom)", fontsize=11)
axC.legend(fontsize=10); axC.set_ylim(0, 13.5)
axC.set_title("C. The catalytic geometry is preserved, the thiol is absent\n"
              "superposition of 89 CA pairs, RMSD 1.34 A; Ser212 CB sits 1.76 A from Cys113 CB",
              fontsize=12, loc="left")

# ---------------- Panel D: first shell and AlphaMissense constraint
axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
fsres = [("Cys113","Ser212",0.918,True),("His23","His143",0.572,False),
         ("Asn112","Asn211",0.802,False),("Glu114","Glu213",0.996,False),
         ("Trp24","Trp144",0.983,False),("Phe116","Phe215",0.995,False),
         ("His35","His155",0.951,False),("His115","Ser214",0.862,True)]
names = [f"{a} -> {b}" for a, b, _, _ in fsres]
vals = [v for _, _, v, _ in fsres]
sub = [s for _, _, _, s in fsres]
y = np.arange(len(fsres))[::-1]
axD.barh(y, vals, color=["#e8554e" if s else "#4393c3" for s in sub])
for yi, v in zip(y, vals):
    axD.text(v+0.01, yi, f"{v:.3f}", va="center", fontsize=9)
axD.set_yticks(y); axD.set_yticklabels(names, fontsize=10)
axD.set_xlim(0, 1.12)
axD.set_xlabel("AlphaMissense mean pathogenicity at the LRATD1 residue", fontsize=10.5)
axD.set_title("D. PLAAT3 first shell mapped onto LRATD1: two substitutions, six conserved\n"
              "red = substituted; the pocket residues remain under strong missense constraint",
              fontsize=12, loc="left")

fig.suptitle("Human LRATD1 (FAM84A, Q96KN4) carries an intact LRAT-fold pocket with a serine "
             "where the catalytic cysteine belongs", fontsize=14, y=0.985)
plt.show()
